scope: INC-02: static JS compatibility only. No old HTML/JSON,backend,collector or private source data published.
source: public-compat/graphs/manifest.json links immutable UTF-8 JS bundles by SHA-256;each module is also SHA-256 checked;each generation imports only itself.
releasePreparation: When frontend/build JS changes,run npm run prepare:js and review generated JS bundles+manifest. Ordinary build fails if current source graph is not explicitly prepared;it never writes source archives.
Commit the current graph and supported earlier graphs with the source change. Data-only R2 updates need no preparation;existing collector/workflows remain unchanged.
No asset is pruned automatically. Maximum16 declared generations;capacity failure blocks build instead of removing a supported graph.

Minimum transition support7days. Before publication ensure retainUntil covers at least7days after replacement of the old current graph;extend metadata if a prepared release was delayed. Asset bytes are immutable.
retirement: Requires a separate owner decision. First verify actual last-publication/replacement time and supported-tab window;expiry is eligibility,not an automatic deletion trigger.
Run npm run prepare:js -- --retirement-plan VERSION... for a read-only plan. Current,unknown or unexpired versions are rejected.

After explicit approval remove only reviewed graph entries and matching source JS bundles;never copy old dist/data or remove current/plain compatibility assets. Keep rollback copies outside public output.

Verify old supported tabs/current generation,build/public allowlist,hashes and cache responses. Exact restored URLs may need separately authorized negative-cache invalidation after existing404;do not change DNS,WAF or disable caching.
limits: Arbitrarily old tabs are not promised indefinite support after an explicitly approved retirement. Within declared support they retain exact asset paths.
Old immutable chat clients retain old behavior until reload. The WebSocket fix runs in the new generation;do not rewrite old content-addressed files.
If capacity is reached while all previous versions remain supported,stop release preparation and review policy;never silently shorten support.
